name: Write PDF
description: Create a PDF document from Markdown and deliver it to the user: in a chat it appears as a download, on email or Telegram it goes out as an attachment of your reply. Use it whenever the user asks for a PDF, a report or a printable document. Write the whole document in 'content' as Markdown (headings, lists, tables, links). Images: ![caption](file.png) with a workspace file (a screenshot from web_screenshot, a chart from make_chart) or an http(s) address of a picture.

path.description: File name of the PDF in the workspace, e.g. report-borgio-verezzi.pdf

content.description: The full document, in Markdown. Start with a '# Title' heading.

title.description: Short human title of the document (defaults to the file name)
